title: RDPSP
description: RDPSP (Random Dimension Player Spawn Points) teleports players to a random dimension when they first join a world. Every player gets a unique starting location, making each playthrough different and unpredictable.
body:
# RDPSP, (Random Dimension Player Spawn Points)

This mod that allows you to randomly spawn in any dimension (With the help of the infinite dimensions mod) In minecraft.

## How it works
On the very first join, the player will be teleported to a completely random dimension, making it a challenge for them to survive, it could be anything, **ANYTHING!** So, be prepared for dimension randomness!
You can also play this mod with multiplayer/with your friends, so yeah. It's a lot of fun!

*TIP:*
*If you are stuck in a dimension, and you really REALLY want to switch dimensions, do `/randomdimension (user/target)` and it will switch the targeted player to a random dimension, be warned, the command only works for operators.*
